versions.source: AJCC Cancer Staging Manual 8th Edition / NCCN / UICC
versions.provenance: 8th edition staging, verified against AJCC 8th edition / NCCN guidelines; licensed verification standard. Requires R1 clinical verification before unchecked use.
versions.introduction: Staging applies to soft tissue sarcomas of the extremity and trunk (the 8th edition stages head/neck, retroperitoneal, visceral and other sites separately). T is purely size-based with 5 cm increments, a distinctive 8th-edition feature; grade uses the FNCLCC system (differentiation, mitotic count, necrosis). Nodal metastasis is rare but upstages to IIIB; pulmonary metastases dominate M1. Superficial vs deep location no longer changes T.

t.label: Tumour 5 cm or smaller in greatest dimension
Tumour larger than 5 cm up to 10 cm in greatest dimension
Tumour larger than 10 cm up to 15 cm in greatest dimension
Tumour larger than 15 cm in greatest dimension

n.label: Regional lymph nodes cannot be assessed
Regional lymph node metastasis (uncommon in most subtypes; more frequent in epithelioid, synovial, clear-cell and angiosarcoma)

versions.regionalNodes: Regional basins follow the anatomic site of the primary (e.g. axillary/inguinal for limb primaries); most sarcomas spread haematogenously, so enlarged nodes are biopsied before being called N1.
versions.histologicGrade: FNCLCC grade: tumour differentiation (1-3) + mitotic count per 10 HPF (1-3) + tumour necrosis (0-2). Total 2-3 = G1 (low), 4-5 = G2 (intermediate), 6-8 = G3 (high). Grade drives stage more than size does.
versions.histopathologicTypes: Undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma, liposarcoma (well-differentiated, dedifferentiated, myxoid, pleomorphic), leiomyosarcoma, synovial sarcoma, malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumour, epithelioid sarcoma, clear-cell sarcoma, angiosarcoma, dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans (rarely metastasises).
prognosticFactors: Depth relative to fascia and margin status
